signals_info.description: Whether the vehicle is actively executing a lane change.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition lane_change_active == 1 shall cease to be true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，lane_change_active == 1 这一条件应刚停止成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The vehicle shall finish executing the lane change at some future time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 车辆应在未来某个时刻结束变道执行。
